title: Power-exponent refinement on cached codes
question: Does p in {0.25, 0.33, 0.66} beat the sealed p=0.5 anywhere?

cell.two_stage: STAGE 1 screens the new p values at 138k (each fit is one Gram accumulation + solves); STAGE 2 promotes AT MOST ONE p (the 138k winner) to the full-data fit and the registered gate. Registered in the section 6 amendment to bound compute.
cell.trained_note: trained-head read at the stage-2 winning p under the C4 trained-head protocol (8 epochs, lr 0.001, seed 201).

anchors.note: the sealed p=0.5 and p=1.0 cells reproduce exactly (C4 protocol): full-data best p0.5_lambda0.1 = 0.278551; 138k p0.5_lambda1.0 = 0.227362 (the C4 cells_138k penalty-1.0 protocol).

gate.registered: stage 2 only: the promoted p's full-data best cell >= sealed p=0.5 best + 0.005 at identical cost, else archived as a scoped negative. A stage-1 p that does not beat p=0.5 at 138k is not promoted.
